name: Fault Lines 30
notes: Faulted stone: 72 half-plane faults at full step - solid polygonal facets with subtle ridge lines along the traces - gating a solid primary. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/fault-lines.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Sparse angular shards on open ground.
